# Medicine

Medicines treat conditions and ailments and improve recovery over time.

## Comfrey Poultice

*Knitbone: the crushed root, bound warm over a bruise.*

A comfrey poultice is administered by contact, bound over a deep bruise. It speeds the healing of bruises and sprains. Swallowed, it poisons.

| Strength | Effect | Side effect | Price |
|:---|:---|:---|:---:|
| Single strength | Bruised to the Bone heals in 1 day instead of 3 | Swallowed, it advances Tainted by 1 tier | 1 ss |

## Honey Dressing

*Honey spread on clean linen and bound over the wound.*

A honey dressing is administered by contact, bound over a wound and kept there. While it stays on, the wound resists infection and heals faster with rest.

| Strength | Effect | Side effect | Price |

## Leech's Eyesalve (brass eyesalve)

*Garlic, leek, wine, and bile, left to steep in a brass vessel until it turns.*

Leech's eyesalve is administered by contact, spread on an infected wound. It drives back infection: a mild one clears, and a worse one is slowed, buying time for a healer. Anyone can apply it.

## Willow Bark

*Bitter inner bark, chewed or steeped. The serf's painkiller.*

Willow bark is administered through ingestion. It dulls mild pain without the sleep that stronger drugs bring, but it sours the stomach. Ginger, added as a Corrected recipe, settles it.

| Strength | Effect | Side effect | Price |

## Counter-Vials

Counter-vials end Attrition. Burning is put out by smothering or dousing it (see Wildfire), and viper wine counters Withering (see Nostrums).

### Alum

*A white mineral salt that puckers the flesh and closes the bleeding.*

Alum is administered by contact, packed into a bleeding wound on yourself or an ally. It stops one wound from bleeding, and it counts as treatment for an Open Wound.

| Strength | Effect | Side effect | Price |
|:---|:---|:---|:---:|
| Single strength | Ends one instance of Attrition (Bleeding). Counts as the *Stop the bleeding* treatment for an Open Wound Trauma | None | 1 ss |
